verdict.rationale: GlitchTip documents frequency-based alert conditions and the ability to ignore an issue (shown through its MCP update_issue tool), which covers part of the anti-noise story. There is no evidence of spike protection or per-key rate limits; the spike-related pricing text describes billing for overage rather than throttling, and SDK trace sampling is an adjacent client-side control. Missing for 10: spike protection, per-DSN/per-key rate limits, documented mute/snooze rules in the alerting UI, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can fight alert fatigue with spike protection, per-key rate limits, and mute/ignore rules so one bad deploy doesn't page the whole team all night

citations.quote: Here you can specify when you want to receive alerts based on the frequency of errors.
update_issue — Resolve, unresolve, or ignore an issue
